heroHeadline: Intellia Nex-z Phase 3 Trials Resume; Beam BEAM-302 AATD Pivotal Set for H2 2026; Lonvo-z BLA Advances
heroSubtitle: May 11, 2026: Intellia Therapeutics Q1 results confirm the MAGNITUDE and MAGNITUDE-2 Phase 3 trials of nex-z (in vivo CRISPR for ATTR amyloidosis) have resumed patient screening after FDA clinical holds were lifted, while the lonvo-z rolling BLA progresses toward a targeted H1 2027 US launch for hereditary angioedema. May 7, 2026: Beam Therapeutics reports $1.2B cash runway to mid-2029, selects 60 mg BEAM-302 as optimal dose for AATD pivotal cohort (H2 2026 initiation), and targets risto-cel BLA year-end 2026 — building toward two base-editing therapy approvals. The CRISPR pipeline continues its acceleration across liver, blood, and oncology indications.
footerNote: Data sourced from FDA, EMA, MHRA, NIH, peer-reviewed journals (Nature, Science, NEJM, Cell), ClinicalTrials.gov, and major science outlets. Clinical data reflects published peer-reviewed results only.
